name: MailUp
description: MailUp is a comprehensive email and SMS marketing platform designed to help businesses create, send, and analyze their marketing campaigns. With a user-friendly interface and powerful automation tools, MailUp enables users to reach their audience effectively and efficiently.

events.d: Create a new email message on the specified list.
Sends the specified message (previously created in MailUp in the specified List) to the email address specified.
Create a new text message on the specified list.
Send a message to a predefined group in the specified list.
Delete a text message of a specified list.
Add the recipient to the specified group on the list.
Adds a new recipient to the specified list as a subscriber.
Unsubscribe the given recipient from the specified list.
Add a new group to the specified list.
